scope: Google Search Console only (92 snapshots, 2026-05-07 to 2026-08-19) joined to the 83-keyword master tracking list. Competitor #1-blocker analysis and AI-visibility tracking are NOT included here — GSC cannot produce them honestly and they remain manual.
wins: Core brand-category terms hold the top of page 1: 'bariatric therapy' at #1.0 and 'bariatric counseling' at #2.9 — the latter up from #25.0 on the 2026-05-07 reference snapshot and #17.8 in early July.

'weight loss counseling' posted the strongest positive move of any tracked term, +5.5 positions to #18.2, and is the only tracked keyword to convert a click this snapshot (1 click on 5 impressions); it was #41.2 in early July.

The San Antonio eating-disorder cluster improved sharply month over month: 'eating disorder counseling san antonio' #23.7 to #13.3 (12 impressions) and 'eating disorder therapist san antonio' #24.5 to #14.9 (10 impressions).

Keyword coverage widened since the 2026-08-17 run: 18 of 83 tracked keywords now register impressions (was 15), and the 'not ranking' bucket fell from 68 to 65 keywords. New entrants include 'overeaters anonymous san antonio' at #10.0 and 'nutritional counseling san antonio tx' at #27.4.

The hydration blog post remains the site's dominant impression generator at 6,289 impressions and 17 clicks at an average position of 7.2 — more than seven times the impressions of the next best page (847).
needs_attention: Coverage is thin: 18 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show impressions; 65 show none. This is a keyword count, not a page count — many keywords map to the same target page, and it should never be read as a number of pages or of unpublished pages. Tracker hygiene is close to clean: the 83 keyword entries point at 50 distinct target pages, of which 49 are live www URLs and only 1 is a staging URL, so the 65 zero-impression keywords are mostly genuine non-ranking terms rather than stale pointers.

Visibility has drifted down across the snapshot window: impressions fell from 2,447 on 2026-05-07 to 1,593 on 2026-08-19 (about -35%), and impression-weighted average position worsened from 14.87 to 17.96. The last seven days run counter to that trend — position improved from 20.1 on 08-12 to 17.96 on 08-19 — so the near-term direction is positive inside a weaker three-month baseline.

CTR is near zero. The site drew 10 clicks on 1,593 impressions site-wide (0.63%), and the top page converts worst of all: the hydration post takes 6,289 impressions at position 7.2 for 17 clicks (0.27%). Page-1 real estate is not being turned into visits.

Commercial bottom-of-funnel terms slipped: 'bariatric counseling near me' fell 6.2 positions to #13.0 (it was #5.8 in early July, so it has dropped out of the top 10), 'bariatric surgery counseling' fell 5.7 to #15.0, and 'bariatric psychological evaluation near me' fell 2.5 to #27.4 despite carrying 23 impressions — the highest impression count of any tracked keyword.

Directional only: several tracked terms sit on 1-5 impressions, where a single search can swing average position by several places day to day. Treat individual position deltas on low-impression keywords as noise unless they persist across multiple runs.
priority_actions: Finish keyword-tracker hygiene: exactly one of the 50 distinct target pages in keywords-master.json still points at staging (staging12 /what-is-a-bariatric-counselor/). Repoint it to the live www equivalent, or confirm it is genuinely not yet live, so GSC can match it. The remaining 49 targets are already live www URLs.

Fix CTR on the hydration post first — it is the single largest lever on the site. 6,289 impressions at position 7.2 producing 17 clicks means the title and meta description are losing the click. Rewrite both, and add a clear CTA plus an internal link from that post into the weight-management and emotional-eating service pages so the traffic that does land has somewhere to convert.

Defend and refresh the slipped bottom-of-funnel pages: 'bariatric counseling near me' (-6.2 to #13.0), 'bariatric surgery counseling' (-5.7 to #15.0), and especially 'bariatric psychological evaluation near me', which carries 23 impressions but sits at #27.4. On-page refresh with San Antonio intent signals on the psych-eval page is the highest-value single edit.

Capture demand GSC is already surfacing that no tracked page owns: 'bariatric therapist near me' (35 impressions, position 14.2), 'mounjaro vs zepbound vs ozempic' (31 impressions, position 10.8), and 'emotional eating' (47 impressions, position 71.0 — high demand, no ranking page). The first two are near-miss page-2 terms that an on-page pass could move.

Add FAQ schema to the top service and BOFU pages for rich-result and AI-overview eligibility, and protect the terms already holding #1-#3 ('bariatric therapy', 'bariatric counseling') with internal links from the high-impression blog posts.

If a staging-to-production publish backlog is in play, confirm the real push list with a staging-vs-prod sitemap diff or Daniel's own notes. No count can be derived from GSC or keyword data, and none is asserted here.
summary: SEO is directionally improving in the short term — average position moved from 20.1 to 17.96 over the last week, keyword coverage rose from 15 to 18 of 83 tracked keywords since Monday, and the San Antonio eating-disorder cluster gained roughly 10 positions month over month — but impressions remain about 35% below the early-May baseline and CTR is the binding constraint, with 10 clicks on 1,593 impressions site-wide. The highest-value moves are a title/meta and CTA fix on the hydration post (6,289 impressions at position 7.2, 0.27% CTR) and an on-page refresh of the slipped bottom-of-funnel bariatric psych-eval and near-me pages.
